A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same PlanGenLLMs survey, with matching authors, six performance criteria, Figure 1, and eleven appendix tables. The text and visual material support a reliable comparison, including the complete appendices.

before.justification: v1 surveys existing research. Numerical outcomes in Tables 1–11 are attributed to cited studies; it reports no original experiments, simulations, user studies, or empirical data-analysis results.

after.justification: v2 retains the same literature-derived results in Tables 1–11 and introduces no original empirical investigation. Its additions concern explanations, references, and resource access.

M1.justification: Neither version introduces a planning algorithm or model. Section 8's expanded explanation of Thought of Search clarifies successor and goal-check functions already described in Tables 2 and 11, without changing the method.

E1.justification: No training or evaluation coverage changes. Figure 1 replaces APIBench with API-Bank, but this is a survey-reference change rather than a dataset actually evaluated by this work. The appendix dataset entries remain identical.

E2.justification: The comparisons summarized in Tables 1–11 are unchanged. Figure 1 corrects LAST to LATS, referring to the same Zhou et al. (2023a) method already named LATS in v1's Table 2.

E3.justification: Section 9 retains the same evaluation methods and metrics, and the appendix settings are unchanged. The added five-hour flight-booking example in Section 3 is illustrative, not a revised experimental budget.

E4.justification: No ablations, robustness tests, sensitivity analyses, or empirical case studies are added or removed. The appendix analyses remain unchanged; the new grounding examples illustrate concepts without reporting tests.

E5.justification: Neither version adds or revises run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The retained literature summaries use the same statistical reporting practices.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative result entries in Tables 1–11 are retained. For example, Table 2 reports LATS at 92.7% Pass@1 on HumanEval and 75.9% success on WebShop in both versions.

T1.justification: Section 5 qualifies v1's statement that A* always finds an optimum by introducing admissible heuristics that do not overestimate remaining cost. It also explicitly states that DFS/MCTS lack optimality guarantees. These are limited revisions to mathematical conditions and guarantees; no proof or derivation is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contribution: organizing LLM planning around six performance criteria, reviewing evaluation approaches, and identifying research gaps. The additions do not redefine this scope.

C2.justification: Section 5 adds a substantive comparison between classical planners and optimizers. Section 7 changes generalized planning's description from tackling larger, more complex tasks to solving unseen same-domain tasks that may be larger or more complex. The dedicated Discussion and Limitations sections retain their substance.

D1.justification: v2 adds a first-page footnote providing a repository link for a curated list of papers and resources. v1 lacks this access information. No implementation settings, hardware details, or experimental reproduction instructions are added.

R1.justification: v2 adds limited references, including Li et al. (2025), Tantakoun et al. (2025), model documentation, and planning/optimization textbooks. Figure 1 replaces APIBench/Patil with API-Bank/Li, and the Patil reference is removed. The survey's overall research positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: Targeted additions explain correctness, object/action grounding, optimality, generalized planning, and search functions. v2 also adds acknowledgements and makes small wording corrections. The main section sequence and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 receives label and citation edits, including LAST-to-LATS and APIBench-to-API-Bank. Spacing and page layout change, and printed page numbers disappear. All eleven appendix tables retain their structure and content; no figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves the survey's clarity through concrete grounding examples and clearer explanations of generalized planning and search functions. Section 5 usefully qualifies the previously unconditional A* statement, while updated references and resource access information improve usability. The expanded optimizer comparison still leaves the assumptions behind its optimality guarantees unspecified. Overall, these are limited gains within an otherwise unchanged survey and appendix evidence base.
